description: Chronological log of core actions that created the We.Publish knowledge base. All times 2026-06-11 UTC (single working session). No secrets in this file.

actions.detail: Verified resize landed: 8 vCPU / 15.6 GiB / 70 GiB free, x86_64, Ubuntu 26.04 'resolute' (Docker apt repo confirmed available), no Docker installed.

Pre-run fixes against the v0.25.6 tag: container-name auto-detect (no container_name in tag's compose), loopback rewrite of every published port in .env (Docker bypasses ufw), SIGPIPE-safe secret generation (tr|head under pipefail kills the script).

deploy.sh: Docker Engine + compose installed, RAGFlow v0.25.6 cloned to /opt/ragflow, .env written (full image, INIT_MODEL_PROVIDER_TABLES=0, generated MySQL/MinIO/Redis secrets, all ports 127.0.0.1-bound), stack started (es01, mysql, minio, redis, ragflow-cpu).

Health probe 404s exposed the v0.25.6 API restructure: all routes moved to /api/v1/* (old /v1/user/* gone); login token returned in lowercase 'authorization' header; in-process bge-m3 removed in favour of a TEI sidecar.
actions.result: configure script + health probe rewritten against tag source

actions.detail: tei-cpu profile enabled with TEI_MODEL=BAAI/bge-m3. First start kernel-OOM-killed (~8.9 GiB warmup RSS, dmesg-confirmed). Fixed with --max-batch-tokens 4096 override.
actions.result: TEI healthy; bge-m3 embeddings serving (German verified)

actions.detail: Headless config: admin user registered, /system/tokens API key minted, datasets created: public, internal, newsroom:pilot (embedding BAAI/bge-m3@Builtin, chunk_method naive). Key pulled to laptop .secrets/.
actions.result: 3 empty datasets; retrieval-only (no chat LLM; keyword:true forbidden)

actions.detail: RAGFlow built-in MCP server enabled (self-host mode with minted key, streamable HTTP) on loopback :9382 via docker-compose-mcp.yml override. JSON-RPC initialize handshake verified.
actions.result: retrieval-only MCP live; laptop .mcp.json entry 'ragflow-kb' via SSH tunnel

actions.detail: Built wp-kb ops CLI (health / datasets / query / ingest / tunnel) running API calls on-box over SSH.

No Hetzner private net -> systemd ragflow-tunnel.service: auto-restarting SSH tunnel to onyx01 with dedicated key, authorized restricted (port-forward only to 127.0.0.1:9380/9382, no shell). RAGFLOW_BASE_URL/API_KEY/ALLOWED_DATASET_IDS set in the internal profile .env.
actions.result: Hermes reaches RAGFlow; key never exposed beyond the boxes

actions.detail: Built + deployed the scoped retrieval skill (mirror of kb-ingest: dataset allowlist enforced in query.py, no keyword:true, grounding rules in SKILL.md). Source committed to labs (PR #46).

Canary chunk via kb-ingest -> indexed ~10 s -> kb-retrieve hit (similarity 0.40) -> 'hermes -p internal chat' answered using the skill with the Answer/Source/Confidence/Provenance contract -> canary deleted.
actions.result: full loop proven; KB returned to empty

actions.detail: 3 independent reviewer agents attacked the resource plan. Key refutations adopted: client-batch-size 8 would 413 all ingest (RAGFlow batches 16); concurrency cap rejects live queries; warmup memory is quadratic; TEI queue livelock for 2049-8192-token inputs (fixed by max_seq_length clamp); ES must be excluded from swap; heap must be pinned; pull-only monitoring rejected; 6GB swap oversized.

Applied: TEI --max-batch-tokens 2048 + --tokenization-workers 2 + MALLOC_ARENA_MAX=2 + mounted sentence_bert_config clamp (max_seq_length 2048) + mem 6g/6g; ES MEM_LIMIT 3 GiB + ES_JAVA_OPTS -Xms1g -Xmx1g + memswap=mem; ragflow-cpu: adminserver dropped, healthcheck added, 6g/8g caps; 3GB swapfile swappiness=10; docker log rotation 50m x3; COMPOSE_FILE in .env (bare 'docker compose up -d' correct).
actions.result: TEI 6.1 -> 2.1 GiB; box 7.3/15.6 GiB; all containers healthy

actions.detail: Second canary loop on the lightened stack: ingest -> indexed 10 s -> retrieved -> deleted.

onyx01: read-only watchdog (containers, OOM/restart deltas via docker inspect + /proc/vmstat, disk 80%, digestion probe for docs stuck parsing >2h, atomic status JSON) + nightly mysqldump (14-day rotation). hermes01: kb-watch poller probing end-to-end through the tunnel, Slack post ONLY on state transitions. Cadence 10 min (reduced from 5 on Tom's request; daily heartbeat removed).

Deliberate reboot while zero users. Everything returned unattended in <1 min: swap from fstab, all six containers healthy, tunnel auto-reconnected. Poller recorded the down (critical) and recovery (ok) transitions.

Tom installed the persistence (cron files on onyx01; kb-watch systemd timer on hermes01 — agent is permission-blocked from installing persistence). First cron-driven watchdog run verified (seq 2, fresh).

labs PRs: #46 kb-retrieve skill; #47 knowledge-engine project (access guide, runbook, deploy scripts, specs migration, wp-kb, AGENTS.md, TODO.md, this log) + handover update at src/handover/. wp-knowledge/ directory migrated into labs; secrets zipped out-of-band (kb-secrets-2026-06-11.zip), never committed.

KB population plan (specs/plans/2026-06-11-001) landed on main per Tom (no PR ceremony). Scope: thorough repo/CMS/docs understanding for Hermes support + PR/ticket drafting + dev context on newsrooms. Bajour chosen as pilot newsroom.
actions.result: plan supersedes the TODO population checklist

actions.detail: U1: types api_reference + implementation_profile, tags repo_path + commit added to kb-ingest (push_chunk.py) and KNOWLEDGE_BASE_SPEC; boundary amended: raw code/SDL/Prisma never embedded, derived prose allowed with provenance + refresh manifest. Deployed to hermes01, canary-validated (fail-closed intact). Dataset newsroom:pilot renamed newsroom:bajour (same ID).

U2: manifest-driven idempotent bulk ingest (tools/kb-bulk + ingest/manifest-*.json + state.json content hashes); dry-run, delete+reupload on change, batched parse with run-status polling. First 100+-doc run exposed a pagination bug in the parse poller (only page 1 read -> stall + 10s API hammering); fixed, parse re-triggered on-box.

U3-U7: public = 125 docs/704 chunks (103 GitBook pages ingested from the gitbook-wepublish-doc repo NOT scraped, llms.txt + llms-full.txt from wepublish#2802 branch, 5 nav-stripped marketing pages, 15 monorepo docs @7a2e66b). internal = 31 docs/77 chunks (24 generated API domain references verified against the SDL, 3 pilot newsroom profiles bajour/tsri/hauptstadt, 4 ops seed docs). All parses DONE; watchdog ok; memory 7.7/15.6 GiB steady. Secrets scan over generated content clean.

U8: 32-question DE/EN/FR eval. Dataset-default weighting (vector 0.3) scored 24/32 — German morphology + cross-lingual French defeat term-matching. vector_similarity_weight 0.7 scored 30/32 (public-answerable 96%, ≥90% bar). Adopted per-request in kb-retrieve (deployed to hermes01) + wp-kb; dataset default not API-updatable in v0.25.6, so the MCP path stays at 0.3 (documented).
actions.result: retrieval quality gate passed; eval artifact at ingest/eval-questions.md

verification_summary.retrieval: 2x canary ingest->retrieve->delete loops passed (pre and post lightening)
verification_summary.agent_loop: Aldus answered a KB question via kb-retrieve with the answer contract, unprompted
verification_summary.mcp: JSON-RPC initialize handshake OK from laptop through tunnel
verification_summary.monitoring: down + recovery transitions both observed during the real reboot
verification_summary.memory: 7.3/15.6 GiB steady, every service cgroup-capped, swap untouched
